|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `malformed_message_policy` | **Type**: [NYT::NFlow::EMalformedKafkaMessagePolicy](./all_yson_structs#NYT_NFlow_EMalformedKafkaMessagePolicy)
**Default value**: `fail`
What to do with a record that fails to unpack. `TKafkaSource` passes record values unchanged and never fails to unpack them, so the policy matters only for sources derived from it that unpack records. ||
|#


{% cut "**Additional parameters**" %}


#|
|| `unavailable_threshold` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `5m`
How long the source must be continuously unavailable for the partition to count as stably unavailable. Only time during which the job was running and seeing the failure counts: a gap between restarts is not charged, and any successful answer from the source resets the total. ||
|| `poll_timeout` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `200ms`
Timeout of one consumer poll. ||
|| `watermark_update_period` | **Type**: [TDuration](./all_yson_structs#TDuration)
**Default value**: `5s`
How often the low and high watermarks of the partition are refreshed. They drive the lag and backlog metrics and the detection of a recreated topic. ||
|#
